about_the_game:
About This Game

You find yourself in a pitch-dark, unfamiliar corridor, and your only “weapon” is your curiosity.
In this absurd dark comedy walking simulator, every door leads you to different and strange rooms—sometimes testing your nerves, other times triggering your laughter.
You'll be scared, you'll laugh... but most of all, you'll find yourself asking, “How do I get out of here?”

Features
• Horror + Comedy: Jumpscares and unexpected jokes collide in the same scene; tension and humor entwine.
• Pure Walking Simulator: No weapons, no combat; progression relies entirely on exploration and environmental interactions.
• A Different Surprise Behind Every Door: You never know what awaits on the other side.
• Environmental Storytelling: Objects and wall writings deepen the dark comedy atmosphere.
• Atmospheric Sound Design: A dynamic sound landscape balanced with eerie hums, voice cues, and absurd jingles.

Will you escape, or will you remain the main character of this dark comedy?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains cartoonish nudity presented in a comedic context (e.g. a character with a sausage-shaped body part), exaggerated explosion effects, and occasional depictions of blood and dead bodies. All mature content is intended for dark comedy and parody purposes.
